subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should OpenClaw keep this issue as the canonical broad tracker for cost-first fallback ordering plus guardrail coordination, and what capability authority should configured `models.providers.*.models[*].input` use?
rationale: The code can be changed in several ways, but the safe behavior depends on maintainer intent for cost-vs-quality fallback policy and for whether custom provider input metadata should be rejected, warned, or override-gated.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Use this issue for the fallback benchmark/order decision and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 as the focused model-input guardrail contract work.

options.title: Split Fallback Policy Again
options.body: Open or designate a new canonical fallback-policy issue, then close this broad tracker only after both halves are linked to live canonical work.

options.title: Defer Strict Guardrails
options.body: Keep configured input metadata permissive for now and limit near-term work to diagnostics, docs, and benchmark-backed fallback ordering.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the fallback benchmark/order decision and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 as the focused model-input guardrail contract work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from related fallback/config history and the live issue timeline mention/subscription.
